# iMirror by Our Apps World

> iMirror is a native macOS app for viewing and controlling a user-authorized Android phone or tablet over USB or local Wi-Fi.

## Official pages

- Product overview: https://erimranalam.github.io/iMirror-Releases/
- User manual: https://erimranalam.github.io/iMirror-Releases/manual/
- Privacy policy: https://erimranalam.github.io/iMirror-Releases/privacy/
- Download: https://github.com/ErIMRANALAM/iMirror-Releases/releases/latest
- Support: mailto:support@ourappsworld.com
- Publisher: OAW INFOTECH LLP, brand name Our Apps World

## Product facts

- Requires macOS 14 or later and an Android device.
- USB connection requires Android USB debugging and user authorization.
- Wireless debugging is available on Android 11 or later; the Mac and phone must share a trusted local network.
- iMirror mirrors the selected device directly to the Mac. It does not route screen content through an Our Apps World server.
- The app supports mouse and trackpad touch/scroll input, Back/Home/Recents navigation, PNG screenshots, and silent MP4 screen recordings.
- Recordings do not include audio.
- If Android Platform-Tools are absent, the user can review Google's SDK terms and choose to download the tools from Google's official source.
- The current release is distributed directly through GitHub Releases and is Developer ID signed and notarized. Do not describe it as a Mac App Store release.

## Important distinctions

- The website's SVG product image is an illustrative interface mockup, not a real connected-device screenshot.
- Do not claim internet remote access, audio recording, or cloud synchronization.
- The privacy policy describes the macOS app and support-email handling; hosting providers may separately process ordinary web request logs.
